question_text: Choose the best answer from the alternatives.
stimulus: a. International Workers Day is observed on ―. (i) May 10 (ii) May 01 (iii) June 26 (iv) July 25 b. The objective of May Day was to establish ― workday. (i) a six-hour (ii) an eight-hour (iii) an eighteen-hour (iv) a seven-hour c. The workers had been working 14 or even more hours a day since ― Revolution. (i) Green (ii) French (iii) Industrial (iv) European d. The events of ― was a reminder. (i) May 1, 1886 (ii) May 1, 1868 (iii) June 1, 1886 (iv) June 1, 1868 e. The ― were working fourteen or even more bours a day. (i) students (ii) farmers (iii) doctors (iv) workers f. About ― workers joined the rally. (i) 600 (ii) 6000 (iii) 1600 (iv) 160 g. The rally was addressed by the ―. (i) labourers (ii) political leaders (iii) labour leaders (iv) public leaders
guide_solution: a (ii) May 01; b. (ii) an eight-hour; c. (ii) Industrial; d. (i) May 1, 1886; e. (iv) workers; f. (ii) 6000; g. (iii) labour leaders; h. (i) bosses; i. (iv) 200policemen; j. (iv) none of them; k. (i) motivate; l. (iv) surrender; m. (iii) adverb; n. (iv) club and revolver.

subject: English
stimulus: a. What lesson do you get from the events of 1 st May 1886? b. Why is May Day observed today? c. How many workers were killed and injured? d. What was the demand of the workers? e. How long did the working people have to work since industrial revolution?
guide_solution: a. We get lesson from the events of 1 st May 1886 that workers all over the world should be united for their better working conditions, better pay and better lives. b. Today May Day is observed to commemorate the historical struggle and sacrifices of the working people to establish an eight hour workday. c. Many workers were victimized for taking part in the strike. One striker was killed, five or six were wounded and many of the workers were badly injured. d. Eight hour workday was the demand of the workers. 7 e. The working people had to work fourteen or even more hours a day since industrial revolution. f. The Trade Unions inspired the workers. g. The labour leaders addressed the rally. h. The leader urged the workers to stand together, to go on with their struggle and not to give in to their bosses. i. About 6000 workers joined the rally. j. The policemen attacked the strikers with clubs and revolvers. k. The workers had to work fourteen or even more hours a day before the May 1 strike. l. One striker was killed, five or six others were wounded and many of the workers were badly injured for taking part in the strike. m. The workers in Chicago went on a strike demanding an eight-hour workday. n. The events of May 1, 1886 is a reminder that workers all over the world should be united in their fight for just cause.
